states: Matched production renderer at Chromium desktop light and WebKit emulated phone dark using the same fixed clock and synthetic Proxmox reads.
With the PVE workload snapshot unreadable, Backup health and the collapsed Coverage group retain the counts without calling those backup groups unmatched.
An expanded VM 100 group explains why no match could be checked, and still shows the verified PBS point. By date keeps all three restore points inspectable.
After a successful scoped workload retry, the recovered guest is protected with its PVE and PBS points, and VM 999 remains the single genuinely unmatched group.
interactions: Open the unassessed group, inspect VM 100 restore evidence, navigate to By date and expand the PBS point using Enter on desktop or touch on phone.
Retry while the By date detail is open. Only the failed workload snapshot is reread; the action is unavailable while pending, and the point stays open after recovery.
On desktop, the cleared Retry gives focus back to the active By date tab. Return to Coverage and inspect the recovered guest and the genuinely unmatched VM 999.
